* '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Block 1 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009 (slip 105)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=8 Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 8, slip 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=8 Internet Archive]</ref>: “[Pilot] 3. If piloting lead starfighter, Attack Run total is +3. During your control phase, if piloting at a battleground, may ▲ one Darklighter Spin or retrieve 1 Force.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-105-Luke_Skywalker.png]]) prints it. The slip prints slip number 105 at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Luke Skywalker (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 1 list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1210_105">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock1Type (Virtual Block 1 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205209/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142851/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “[Pilot] 3. If piloting lead starfighter, Attack Run total is +3. During your control phase, if piloting at a battleground, may ▲ Darklighter Spin or retrieve 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' One change: “one” before “Darklighter Spin” is dropped. The Players Committee generated the website card list from its Holotable card data, so this wording is that data's transcription of the card; the Players Committee published it on its own website, so it is a version. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes; the text here draws the icons as the printed slips do. The list shows no slip image.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Luke Skywalker (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-L-lukeskywalker-pre.gif]]), on the Players Committee's server by 25 February 2013<ref name="pc-img-date-Virtual1-Light">Players Committee card image folder (<code>Virtual1-Light/large/</code>), web-server directory listing sorted by date: every file last modified 25 February 2013, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034541/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/?C=M;O=A 18 August 2019] (Internet Archive); the file is byte-identical to today's.</ref>: “[Pilot] 3. If piloting lead starfighter, Attack Run total is +3. During your control phase, if piloting at a battleground, may ▲ one Darklighter Spin or retrieve 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word, undoing the card-list changes listed under PC-E1. The date is the bulk upload date of the whole image folder, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (versions ruling of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is a version at its upload date, and what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It prints the same slip number as the release-sheet slip (105).
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Luke Skywalker (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 11)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=11 Internet Archive]</ref>, slip [[:File:VL-history-1210-105-front-master.png]]: “[Pilot] 3. If piloting lead starfighter, Attack Run total is +3. During your control phase, if piloting at a battleground, may ▲ one Darklighter Spin or retrieve 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word (the same words as the PC card image, PC-E2). The Master List slip prints no slip number. Every published text is a version, even a word-for-word repeat (versions ruling of 11 November 2026).
